title: Create paste and run build script and gitignore
description:
Create scripts/build_all.sh and .gitignore. The script must be paste-and-run with zero editing and no placeholders.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakePresets.json (created by a.3) for the exact preset name linux-release and its binaryDir build/linux-release.
- CMakeLists.txt (created by a.3) for the target name ShredSpace and the FORMATS list VST3 LV2 Standalone.
- The directory listing of build/linux-release/ShredSpace_artefacts/Release after a build, to confirm the real on-disk artifact paths for the VST3, LV2, and Standalone outputs under the pinned JUCE revision.

Implement exactly:
1. scripts/build_all.sh begins with #!/usr/bin/env bash. It must NOT use `set -e` (explicitly forbidden), so that every artifact check runs and reports even after an earlier failure. It may use `set -u` and `set -o pipefail` only if that does not abort on a failed check.
2. The script resolves the repository root from its own location (for example REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)") so it runs correctly from any working directory. No hard-coded absolute paths, no ~ expansion assumptions, no TODO or FIXME or <fill-in> placeholders of any kind.
3. It runs `cmake --preset linux-release` then `cmake --build build/linux-release`, capturing each exit status and printing an explicit line for each step.
4. It then checks existence of all three Linux artifacts under build/linux-release/ShredSpace_artefacts/Release: the VST3 bundle, the LV2 bundle, and the Standalone executable. For EACH artifact it prints exactly one line of the form "PASS: VST3 <path>" or "FAIL: VST3 <path>", and likewise for LV2 and Standalone. All three checks always run.
5. It ends by printing a summary line and exiting 0 when all three artifacts exist and configure and build both succeeded, or exiting 1 otherwise.
6. The file is created with the executable bit set (chmod +x scripts/build_all.sh).
7. .gitignore covers at minimum: build/, build-*/, cmake-build-*/, .cache/, compile_commands.json, .vscode/, .idea/, *.user, .DS_Store, and *.swp. It must NOT ignore JUCE/ and must NOT ignore anything under Source/, scripts/, or docs/.

Use only explicit cmake commands; never make or cppcheck.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/build_all.sh exists, starts with #!/usr/bin/env bash, and is executable
scripts/build_all.sh contains no placeholder text such as TODO, FIXME, <fill-in>, or PATH_TO
scripts/build_all.sh invokes cmake --preset linux-release and cmake --build build/linux-release
scripts/build_all.sh prints one explicit PASS or FAIL line for each of the VST3, LV2, and Standalone artifacts, and all three checks run unconditionally
bash scripts/build_all.sh exits with status 0 and prints PASS for all three artifacts
.gitignore ignores build/ and IDE state directories and does not ignore JUCE/, Source/, scripts/, or docs/
Only scripts/build_all.sh and .gitignore are created or modified by this task
forbidden_changes: create or modify any file under JUCE/
create or modify anything under docs/
leave any placeholder, TODO, or path the operator must edit before running
invoke make, cppcheck, clang-tidy, or any tool other than cmake and shell builtins
ignore JUCE/, Source/, scripts/, or docs/ in .gitignore

allowed: choose shell helper function names and the exact summary line wording
choose whether to use set -u and set -o pipefail
choose how to resolve the repository root from BASH_SOURCE
forbidden: introduce a Makefile, CMake changes, or a second build entry point
introduce a build system wrapper in another language
change preset names or artifact directory layout
add cleanup logic that deletes source or JUCE files
